Definition: Naarah, the name of an Israelitess, and of a place in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Naarah is a wife of Ashur the father of Tekoa, and the name also marks a place on the border. In 1 Chronicles 4:5 Ashur has two wives, Helah and Naarah, and in 1 Chronicles 4:6 Naarah bears him four sons. The place appears as Naarath in Joshua 16:7, on the way down from Janohah to Jericho.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a name that belongs to both a mother and a town is a small picture of how the Bible works. People and places carry the same words, and the family line runs through both.
